DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 昔の写真に写っている模型をもう一度見たいです。この建物へ行けば今も見られるか、まず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 昔の写真の模型が当時の建物で今も見られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to see a model in an old photograph again. First, I'd like to check whether I can still see it if I go to this building.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the model in an old photograph can still be seen in the building where it was then. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 建物そのものではなく、写真にある模型をお探しなのですね。撮影時期は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: So you're looking for the model in the photo, rather than the building itself. Do you know when the photo was taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 十年ほど前です。建物の名前は覚えていますが、その後に模型が移されたかどうかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 撮影は十年前で模型の移転有無は知らないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: About ten years ago. I remember the building's name, but I don't know whether the model has been moved since then.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the photograph was taken ten years ago and you do not know whether the model has been relocated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真を見せていただけますか。背景に展示の名前はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you show me the photo? Is the exhibition's name visible in the background?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 模型の横に展示名の一部が写っています。建物名だけでなく、この文字も手がかりに使えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 写真に残る展示名の文字も手掛かりとして示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Part of the exhibition name appears beside the model. These letters, as well as the building name, might be useful clues.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Point out the letters of the exhibition name visible in the photograph as another clue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 常設の模型か、期間限定の展示かを確認しましょう。今日は撮影場所にも立ち寄りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's check whether it was a permanent model or a temporary exhibition. Would you also like to stop by the place where the photo was taken today?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 模型を見つける方を優先したいです。今の展示場所が別なら、当時の建物への道案内だけではなくそちらを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 建物より模型を優先し別の展示場所ならそちらを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd rather prioritize finding the model. If it's now exhibited somewhere else, please tell me about that place, rather than just giving directions to the building it was in then.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the model matters more than the building and you want to know its other exhibition location if it has moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 現在の所在はまだ確認できていません。問い合わせ先をお伝えするので、展示しているか確かめてから出発できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We haven't confirmed its current whereabouts yet. I'll give you a contact, so you can check whether it is on display before setting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。「場所が分かった」と思ってすぐ出発せず、模型が今も公開されているか問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 所在と公開を問い合わせてから出発すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I won't leave straight away thinking I know where it is; I'll ask whether the model is still open to the public.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about its location and public display before setting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、写真の文字と確認先をメモにします。見つかるといいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll note the letters from the photograph and where to check. I hope you find it.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。作業を始める前に何か確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Is there anything you would like to check before starting work?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 足元に張ってあるひもが気になります。歩きやすくするために外していいのか、何かの目印なのかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 足元のひもを外せるか用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm wondering about the string stretched near our feet. Please tell me whether I can remove it to make walking easier or whether it marks something.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what the string near your feet is for and whether it can be removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 植える位置を合わせるためのひもです。どこを通ろうとしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's a string for aligning the planting positions. Where were you trying to go?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 道具を取りに向こう側へ行こうとしていました。ひもを抜けば近道になると思いましたが、勝手には動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 道具への近道を考えたがひもを動かしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I was going to the other side to get a tool. I thought removing the string would make a shortcut, but I haven't moved it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you considered a shortcut to the tools but have not moved the string. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのまま残してください。移動は外側の通路からできます。ひもに足は引っかかっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please leave it where it is. You can use the outer passage. Have your feet caught on the string at all?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ引っかかっていません。今いる場所から一度通路へ戻って、外側を回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: まだ引っかかっておらず通路へ戻り外側を回ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Not yet. I'll go back from here to the passage and go around the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you have not caught your feet and will return to the passage and go around the outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。道具を持って戻る時にも、ひもの内側へ入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Don't go inside the string when coming back carrying the tools either.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。両手に道具を持ってひもをまたごうとせず、戻る時も同じ通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 道具を持ってまたがず帰りも外側通路を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I won't try to step over the string with tools in both hands; I'll use the same passage on the way back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will not step over it carrying tools and will use the outside passage on the return too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。ほかの参加者がひもを外そうとしていたら、どう伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do that. If another participant is about to remove the string, what will you tell them?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 植える位置の目印なので動かさず、外側を通るように伝えます。説明できない点は私が判断せず、先生に聞いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 他の人へ基準線を動かさないと説明し不明点は指導者へ任せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll tell them it's a planting-position marker, so they should leave it and go around the outside. For anything I can't explain, I won't decide myself; I'll ask them to check with the instructor.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain to others not to move the guide line and refer unclear points to the instructor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 植える位置のひもは動かさず、行きも帰りも外側の通路を使う方法を確認できました。道具を取りに行く際も足元にお気を付けください。作業前にお尋ねくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: We've confirmed that you will leave the planting string in place and use the outer passage both ways. Please watch your footing when fetching the tools too. Thank you for asking before starting work.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学中に何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Can I help you during your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 畳に座ってよいと聞いたので、ここで感想を書きたいです。展示してある机も使っていいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 畳で感想を書く際展示机も利用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I heard we can sit on the tatami, so I'd like to write my impressions here. May I also use the desk on display?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may use the display desk when writing your impressions while on the tatami. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 畳に座ることと、展示家具を使うことは別です。この机に紙を置こうとしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sitting on the tatami and using display furniture are separate things. Were you about to put paper on this desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。座れるなら机も使えると思いましたが、まだ紙や筆箱は置いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 座れることから机使用を想像したがまだ物は置かないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I thought being allowed to sit meant I could use the desk too, but I haven't put any paper or my pencil case on it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that permission to sit made you think the desk was usable too, but you have not put anything on it yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机は展示品なので使えません。ご自分のひざの上でメモを取ることはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The desk is an exhibit, so you can't use it. You may take notes on your own lap.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。机には触れず、ノートをひざに乗せて短く書きます。ほかの人が入ってきたら移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 机に触れずひざ上で短く記録し他の来館者が来たら移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I won't touch the desk; I'll put my notebook on my lap and write briefly. I'll move if other people come in.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will write briefly on your lap without touching the desk and move if other visitors arrive. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入口側の通り道を空けて座ってください。筆記具はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please sit with the passage by the entrance kept clear. Do you have something to write with?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 鉛筆を持っています。筆箱を広げず一本だけ出し、書いたらすぐしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鉛筆一本だけ出し筆箱を広げずすぐ片付けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have a pencil. I won't spread out my pencil case; I'll take out just one pencil and put it away as soon as I've written.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will take out only one pencil without spreading out the pencil case and put it away promptly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それでお願いします。展示品についての質問も書いておくと、後で案内の際にお答えできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do that. If you also note your questions about the exhibits, we can answer them during the guidance later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、机を使えるかという疑問と、形が珍しい理由を別々に書きます。使えないことだけで形の意味まで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 使用可否と机の形の理由を別の疑問として記録すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll separately note my question about whether the desk can be used and why it has an unusual shape. I won't infer the meaning of its shape just from the fact that it can't be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will record permission to use the desk and the reason for its shape as separate questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ゆっくりご見学ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. Please enjoy your visit at your own pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日の相談内容を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. May I ask what you would like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 売上のメモを作りましたが、請求書の税込合計と、手数料を引かれた入金額を同じ欄に書いてしまいました。整理の仕方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 請求税込額と手数料差引後入金を同じ欄に書いた整理相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I made sales notes, but I wrote the invoice's tax-inclusive total and the payment received after fees in the same column. I'd like advice on organizing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask how to organize an invoice's tax-inclusive amount and the payment after fees that you recorded in the same column. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 元の請求書と入金の記録は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you still have the original invoice and payment record?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 両方あります。金額が違う理由を確かめる前に、請求書の方を入金額に合わせて書き直すところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 両方の資料があり原因確認前に請求額を変えようとしたと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have both. Before checking why the amounts differed, I was about to rewrite the invoice amount to match the payment received.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you have both records and were about to change the invoice amount before checking the reason for the difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 元の資料は変えず、どちらの金額を転記したか分かるようにしましょう。手数料の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Don't change the original documents; make it clear which amount you copied. Do you have a record of the fees?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 振込の明細に記載があります。差額が全部手数料だと推測せず、明細と一件ずつ照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手数料明細があり差額を推測せず個別照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: They're listed on the transfer statement. Rather than assume the difference is all fees, I'll compare each transaction with the statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you have fee details and will compare individual transactions instead of guessing the difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その整理が必要です。今日のメモでは、対応する請求書の番号も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: That organization is necessary. Can you also identify the corresponding invoice numbers in today's notes?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一部だけ番号を書き忘れています。入金日だけで結び付けず、請求書の番号を探してから対応を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 番号の抜けを探し入金日だけで請求書と結び付けないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I forgot to write some of the numbers. I won't match them by payment date alone; I'll find the invoice numbers before linking them.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will find the missing numbers and not match payments to invoices by payment date alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分からない組み合わせは、未確認として残してください。整理後、税の扱いを改めて相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Leave any unclear matches marked unconfirmed. After organizing them, you can discuss their tax treatment again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。今日ここで数字を一つに決めず、請求額、入金額、手数料を区別した一覧を作ってから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 請求入金手数料の区別一覧を作り未確認を残して再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. Instead of settling on one figure here today, I'll make a list distinguishing the invoiced amounts, payments received, and fees before asking for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will make a list separating invoices, payments, and fees, leave uncertain items unconfirmed, and consult again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料の対応を整理したら、またご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please consult us again once you've organized how the documents correspond.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。お部屋をご覧になる前に、ご希望や確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Before viewing the room, do you have any preferences or points to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家で仕事の通話をするので、普通に話す声が廊下へどのくらい聞こえるか気になります。係の方と短く試してもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 在宅の仕事の普通の声が廊下へ聞こえるか係と短く試したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I make work calls at home, so I'm concerned about how much my normal speaking voice carries into the hallway. Could I briefly test it with a staff member?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to briefly test with staff whether your normal work-from-home speaking voice can be heard in the hallway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 周りの方に配慮して、短い確認にしましょう。実際の仕事の電話をかける予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's keep the check brief out of consideration for others. Are you planning to make an actual work call?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いいえ、仕事の内容や相手の名前は話しません。自分で短い例文を話し、録音もしないで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 仕事の内容や相手の名前は出さず短い例文を話し録音しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: No, I won't mention any work details or anyone's name. I'd like to say a short sample sentence myself and check without recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will not mention work details or other people's names and will say a short example without recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。私は廊下側に立ちます。お客様はどこで話しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I'll stand in the hallway. Where will you speak from?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机を置きたい窓側で話します。玄関のすぐ内側ではなく、普段仕事をするつもりの場所を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 玄関付近でなく机を置く予定の窓側で話すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: From the window side, where I'd like to put my desk. I'll choose where I intend to work normally, rather than just inside the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will speak from the window side where you plan to place the desk rather than near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、ドアを閉めてから普通の声で一度話してください。大声を出す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then close the door and say something once in your normal voice. There's no need to raise your voice.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今、窓側で「明日の打ち合わせは午後です」と普通の声で話しました。音をよく聞いてもらおうとして声を張ることはしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 普通の声で短い例文を一度話し声を張らなかったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I just said 'Tomorrow's meeting is in the afternoon' in my normal voice by the window. I didn't project my voice to make it easier to hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that you said one short example in your normal voice without raising it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今回の位置と声では、廊下で声のあることは分かりましたが、言葉の内容は聞き取れませんでした。別の日や条件でも同じとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: With that position and voice this time, I could tell there was a voice in the hallway, but couldn't make out the words. It may not be the same on another day or under different conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日の短い確認の結果としてメモします。通話の声量や位置で変わることも考え、建物全体が防音だとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 結果は今日の位置と声の条件としてメモし建物全体の防音保証と思わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll note it as the result of today's brief check. I'll consider that it changes with call volume and position, and won't assume the whole building is soundproof.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the result under today's location and voice conditions and will not treat it as a soundproofing guarantee for the entire building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 短い確認はこれで終了です。お客様のメモには今日の位置と条件も残してください。仕事の内容を使わず試していただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: That ends the brief check. Please include today's position and conditions in your notes. Thank you for testing without using work details.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなことをお聞きになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもの集まりで、急に避難の合図を鳴らして反応を競う遊びを考えました。でも本当の避難と間違われそうで、企画を見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 避難合図で反応を競う遊びが実際の避難と混同される懸念を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: For a children's gathering, I thought of a game where an evacuation signal sounds suddenly and they compete to react. But it might be confused with a real evacuation, so I'd like to rethink the plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss the concern that a reaction game using an evacuation signal could be confused with a real evacuation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 急な合図で驚かせる遊びは避けてください。子どもたちに何を学んでほしいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please avoid games that startle them with sudden signals. What would you like the children to learn?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 避難の時に周りの話を聞くことです。速く走った子が勝ちという遊びでは、目的と合わないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 目的は周囲の話を聞くことで走る速さの競争は合わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Listening to the people around them during an evacuation. I think a game where the fastest runner wins wouldn't match that aim.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the aim is listening to others, and a running-speed competition does not suit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 目的を説明してから、落ち着いて話を聞く練習に変えられますね。避難経路は確認済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: You could explain the aim first, then change it to practicing listening calmly. Have you checked the evacuation route?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだです。今日聞いた一般的な話を、その会場の避難経路として使わず、会場の担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 経路未確認で一般助言を会場経路にせず会場担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Not yet. I won't use the general advice I heard today as that venue's evacuation route; I'll check with the venue's person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that the route is unconfirmed and you will check with venue staff rather than treat general advice as the venue route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それが必要です。また、参加しない見学者が練習と分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: That is necessary. Please also make sure observers who aren't participating understand it's practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 子どもだけに説明して終わらず、保護者と会場の担当者にも事前に知らせます。突然合図を流すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 子ども保護者担当へ事前説明し突然の合図を流さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't stop at explaining it just to the children; I'll inform parents and the venue staff in advance too. I won't play a signal suddenly.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain in advance to children, parents, and staff, and will not play a sudden signal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 人数や会場に合う進め方は、企画をまとめて担当者へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please put your plan together and ask the person in charge about a method suited to the number of participants and the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。競争と驚かせる合図を外し、目的、事前説明、会場で確認する事項をまとめます。今日は企画への助言として受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 競争と驚かせる合図を除き目的説明確認事項をまとめて企画相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. I'll remove the competition and startling signal, and summarize the aim, advance explanation, and points to check at the venue. I'll take today's comments as advice on the plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will remove competition and startling signals and organize the aim, explanation, and checks before discussing the plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。安全に配慮した企画になるよう、関係者とご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please discuss it with everyone involved so that the plan takes safety into account.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。家計の資料について、何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your household-budget materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家族と生活費の話をする時、数字だけでは伝えにくいので、簡単な図を作りたいです。口座から出した現金の使い道も入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 家族向けの図に口座から引き出した現金の使い道を入れたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: When talking about living costs with my family, numbers alone are hard to explain, so I'd like to make a simple diagram. Can it include how cash withdrawn from the account is used?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to include how cash withdrawn from the account is used in a diagram for your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご自身の説明用ですね。現金は、どのような支払いに使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's for your own explanation, then. What payments do you use the cash for?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 駅前の店で買う野菜と、子どものおやつです。引き出してすぐ全部使うわけではなく、財布に残る分もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 野菜とおやつを現金で買い財布に未使用分も残ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Vegetables from the shop near the station and snacks for the children. I don't spend it all as soon as I withdraw it; some remains in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you buy vegetables and snacks with cash and some remains unused in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、口座と財布を別の箱に描いてみましょう。財布に入る矢印の先には、何を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's draw separate boxes for the account and wallet. What will you write by the arrow going into the wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 「引き出した現金」と書きます。野菜代は財布から店へ出る矢印にして、まだ残っている分は財布の箱に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 財布への入金矢印と店への支出矢印を描き残額も記したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll write 'cash withdrawn.' I'll make an arrow from the wallet to the shop for vegetable spending and write the amount still left in the wallet box.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you will draw an incoming arrow to the wallet and a spending arrow to the shop, and also note the remaining balance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら、出した現金のその後も話せますね。家族に一番相談したい点は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then you can explain what happens to the withdrawn cash afterward too. What would you most like to discuss with your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: おやつの予算です。減らすと先に決めず、今の買い方を図で見せて、どのくらいにするか一緒に話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: おやつ予算を一方的に減らさず図を見せて家族と決めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The snack budget. Rather than decide to reduce it first, I'd like to show our current buying habits in the diagram and discuss together how much it should be.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say that you want to show the diagram and decide the snack budget with your family instead of cutting it unilaterally. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 図には分かっている数字だけを書き、未確認の分は後で調べられるよう空けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Write only figures you know in the diagram and leave unconfirmed amounts blank so you can check them later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 野菜代はレシートで分かります。おやつ代はまだそろっていないので、その欄を空けて家で確かめます。家族には、この図を使って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 野菜代は記入し未確認のおやつ代を空けて家で調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I know the vegetable spending from the receipts. I haven't gathered all the snack costs yet, so I'll leave that section blank and check at home. I'll use this diagram to discuss it with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say that you will enter vegetable costs and leave unconfirmed snack costs blank to check at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 口座、財布、支払い先の三つを描けましたね。数字をそろえてからご家族とのお話にお使いください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKS-SHIRAKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: We've drawn the account, wallet, and payees. Please use it for your family discussion after gathering the figures. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物ではなく、今落とされた物のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about something you just dropped, rather than something you left behind?

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。浴室で小さい鍵を落としました。足元がよく見えず、手探りで探す前にお知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 浴室で鍵を落とし視界不良の手探り前に報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I dropped a small key in the bathing area. I can't see the floor well, so I'd like to tell you before searching for it by touch.
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you dropped a key in the bathing area and are reporting it before feeling around where visibility is poor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に探さず、どの場所か教えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't strain to search; please tell me where it happened.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗い場から出る手前です。水の中へ落ちた音は聞いていないので、浴槽の中だとまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗場出口前で落とし浴槽落下までは未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just before leaving the washing area. I didn't hear it fall into water, so I don't know that it's in the bathtub.
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you dropped it near the washing-area exit and have not confirmed it fell in the bathtub. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係が場所と状況を確認します。どの鍵でしょうか。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check the place and circumstances. What key is it?

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の鍵で、赤い小さな輪が付いています。施設の鍵ではありませんが、ここで落としたので相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 赤い輪の自宅鍵で施設鍵ではないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's my house key, with a small red ring. It isn't the facility's key, but I dropped it here, so I came to ask for help.
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is your house key with a red ring, not a facility key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の通行を妨げない所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait somewhere that doesn't block other people passing.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友達にも探し回ってもらうのでなく、落とした場所だけ伝えます。見つからないから排水口を開けることもしません。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の探索や排水口開放をせず場所を係へ渡すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than ask my friend to search around too, I'll just tell them where I dropped it. I won't open a drain just because I can't find it either.
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will give staff the location without having friends search or opening a drain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご利用中の荷物は、手元に確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you checked that your belongings for your visit are with you?

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物はあります。鍵が見つかるまで勝手に浴室を使えなくしようとはせず、係の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物所持を確認し鍵待ちで浴室独占せず案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my belongings. I won't try to close off the bathing area myself until the key is found; I'll wait for staff guidance.
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have your belongings and will wait for guidance without monopolizing the bathing area while waiting for the key. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 鍵の特徴と場所を確認しました。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-GIF-GERO-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've noted the key's features and location. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何か気づかれたことがありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入口の所で煙のようなにおいがしました。火が見えたわけではありませんが、すぐ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 煙らしい臭いを感じ火は未確認だが即報告したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I smelled something like smoke near the entrance. I haven't actually seen flames, but I'd like to tell you right away.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you smelled something like smoke and want to report it immediately even though fire is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。今は中へ戻らず、どこで気づいたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us. Don't go back inside for now; please tell me where you noticed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から右の部屋です。展示の説明を全部読んでいないので、実演のにおいだとも異常だとも決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口右部屋で展示実演とも異常とも断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The room to the right of the entrance. I haven't read all the exhibit descriptions, so I can't say whether it's a demonstration smell or something unusual.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was in the room to the right of the entrance and you cannot determine whether it is an exhibit demonstration or an abnormality. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員が状態を確認します。お連れの方はどちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the situation. Where are the people with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一緒にここへ出ています。確かめるためもう一度中へ入ろうとはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者と外へ出て確認目的の再入室もしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They came out here with me. We haven't tried going back inside to check again.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you came outside with your companions and have not reentered to investigate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認の案内があるまで、職員の指示に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow staff instructions until you receive information about the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。自分で窓を開けたり、展示の火の道具を動かしたりせず、においを感じた場所だけ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓や展示器具を自己操作せず案内に従うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't open windows myself or move the exhibit's fire-related tools; I'll just explain where I noticed the smell.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow guidance without operating windows or exhibit equipment yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに、ご自身で見たことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you saw for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 煙が出る所は見ていません。においを感じたことと、煙や火は未確認なことを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 臭い観察と煙火の未確認を区別して話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I didn't see where any smoke was coming from. I'll distinguish smelling something from not having confirmed smoke or flames.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the smell you noticed from the unconfirmed smoke or fire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を受け取りました。それでは、職員の案内をお待ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received your report. Please wait for staff guidance. Thank you for your cooperation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今朝のご出発についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about this morning's departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達だけ先に出ます。私の荷物もまとめられていましたが、私はまだ部屋に残る予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同室友人だけ先出発で自身は残りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only my friend is leaving first. My belongings had been packed up too, but I still plan to stay in the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only your friend sharing the room will leave first and you want to remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お部屋の利用と退出の取扱いを確認しましょう。ご予約は一緒のお部屋ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the arrangements for using and leaving the room. Your reservation is for the same room, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私も同時に出ると友達が思っていました。まず、私は後の出発を希望すると本人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一室予約だが同時出発の誤解を本人へ訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My friend thought I would leave at the same time. First, I'll tell them that I would like to depart later.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you share a room reservation but will correct your friend's misunderstanding about leaving together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付でのお手続きは、宿泊状況を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception will explain the procedures after checking your stay arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。友達が鍵を全部渡せば私の分も終わる、と決めているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵の一括返却を自己分手続完了とせず受付確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't assume that if my friend returns all the keys, my own procedures will be completed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask reception to check rather than treating all the keys being returned together as completion of your own procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お荷物は、それぞれ分けて確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you separated and checked your respective belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これから分けます。私の薬や携帯を友達の袋へ入れたままにせず、先に自分で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬と携帯を友人荷物から分け自分で持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate them now. I won't leave my medicine and phone in my friend's bag; I'll take them myself first.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate your medicine and phone from your friend's luggage and keep them yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる時間や、鍵の扱いは案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the guidance on the time you may use the room and how to handle the keys.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。残る予定だけで延長が認められたとは考えません。私の希望、友達の出発、部屋の取扱いを別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残留希望を延長承認とせず個別予定と室利用を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't assume an extension has been approved just because I plan to remain. I'll discuss my preference, my friend's departure, and the room arrangements separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that wanting to remain does not mean an extension is approved, and you will discuss individual schedules and room use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二人のご予定を確認してご案内します。それでは、お荷物を分けて少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GIF-GERO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check both of your plans and explain. Please separate your belongings and wait a moment. Excuse me.
